name: FigCraft v0.7.0
body:
## What's Changed
* ci: add comfortable runtime limits to unbounded jobs by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/397
* M7: home tests wait for the recent files reader instead of a fixed frame count (#351) by @Barzabel in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/354
* Community batch 1: 22 reviewed fixes by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/507
* M7: follow system theme from the first frame by @VanTan666 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/262
* M7: a slice's export preview shows the page content under it by @ahmed-226 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/265
* M7: double-clicking a page in the Pages list no longer closes the app by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/271
* fix(ui): gradient type icons that show their gradient (#256) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/275
* fix(ui): disable alignment when the selection can't be aligned (#256) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/276
* fix(pen): show the bezier handles while drawing (#256) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/277
* fix(engine): Alt-drag copies snap to their original; Cmd+D repeats the step (#256) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/283
* M1: a press on a corner handle resizes instead of picking the corner-radius handle by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/293
* fix(desktop): Windows' first preferred language picks the UI language (#291) by @fede9234 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/294
* fix(server): keep each team library version in its own file (#206) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/302
* fix(pages): inherit the current page background when adding pages (M1) by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/311
* fix(home): recent files notice files deleted while the home screen is open by @rcoenen in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/318
* fix(home): keep a long path from drawing over the file name in Open files by @patlux in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/324
* M1: SVG export keeps a nested frame's fill and stroke inside its parent's clip by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/327
* M9: a compaction cut short closes the file instead of confirming lost edits (#183) by @Barzabel in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/340
* M7: the Small caps sample in Type settings draws without a box by @StrajnarFilip in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/355
* fix(engine): new text is readable on the frame it is drawn in (#362) by @vxMacDev in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/372
* Copy and paste through the system clipboard in the browser by @mateusvillain in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/375
* Outline stroke on every selected layer, not just the first by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/386
* Keep corner resize cursors diagonal on wide and tall layers by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/388
* Keep text selection highlight inside the box at the end of the text by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/390
* Fix Send to back leaving layers above siblings across frames by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/444
* Community batch 2: 20 reviewed fixes by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/510
* Add Japanese labels for templates, recent files, and editor controls by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/288
* packaging: RPM declares the glibc 2.35 floor, so RHEL 9 refuses it by @tydude001 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/328
* collab: refuse sequence numbers a host cannot advance by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/343
* doc: name counters stop at u64::MAX instead of overflowing by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/344
* Replace every occurrence in edit.findReplace when replacement contains find by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/358
* Reject negative or fractional index in effect.set, export.update and export.remove by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/384
* M4: hanging punctuation test holds for fonts that kern with x offsets by @rcoenen in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/471
* M1: Cmd+R rename test sends Ctrl+R only where Ctrl is the command key by @rcoenen in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/472
* Refuse negative or fractional indexes in page.select and doc.switch by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/475
* fix(engine): read the documented gradient shorthand on every route (#252) by @pcastro93 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/254
* fix(engine): roll back failed commands during interactions too by @notdezzi in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/282
* fix(format): exclusive unique staging files for atomic save/export by @notdezzi in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/284
* M1: open .figcraft files from Finder, Open With and the Dock on macOS by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/290
* Count a recovery revision as copied only after its write succeeds by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/297
* Keep the redo steps when a failed command batch rolls back (#196) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/301
* M1: creating a variable collection no longer closes the app (#224) by @Barzabel in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/314
* M1: deeply nested layers don't run the layout out of stack (#210) by @Barzabel in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/330
* M3: renaming a style folder no longer closes the app by @Barzabel in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/337
* M1: cursor and double-click tests scan the system fonts themselves (#333) by @Barzabel in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/339
* engine: long digit strings no longer overflow object.opacityKeys by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/353
* Community batch 3: 20 reviewed PRs by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/529
* Avoid macOS file dialog reentrancy crashes by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/253
* M9: Russian interface translation by @VanTan666 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/257
* M9: Turkish catalog (reviewed) by @yyamandevrim in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/263
* M6: .fig import lays out the layers of resized instances by their constraints by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/279
* Fix text edits rolling back prior document changes by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/280
* fix(format): import explicit variable modes referenced by asset key by @notdezzi in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/281
* Recovery: wait for the write in flight before an emergency save and before removing copies (#202) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/303
* engine: refuse page.move for node ids that are not pages by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/310
* M0.9: answer control requests while the window is hidden (#269) by @AganzeFelicite in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/313
* fix(recovery): keep the version history and branches in recovery copies (#185) by @vxMacDev in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/331
* M0.9: every hidden window answers control requests, not only the main one (#269) by @patlux in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/332
* M1: keep a recovery copy until this run has its own (#187) by @Barzabel in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/336
* Set the native window identity to match the desktop entry by @IanHollow in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/346
* Make edit.findReplace replace case-insensitive matches by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/361
* i18n: Czech (cs) UI catalog (draft) by @Losminek in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/469
* M7: find Unix user fonts under XDG_DATA_HOME by @IanHollow in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/474
* M9: Indonesian draft catalog by @RevDonz in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/477
* Text: colour emoji draw from their own colour tables (#268) by @fede9234 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/300
* Community batch 4: 11 reviewed PRs by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/530
* fix(ui): scroll a long pages list in its own area so the layers stay in view by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/272
* M1: save files automatically (#296) by @AganzeFelicite in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/305
* M1: leaving Design ends the pen path and goes back to Move by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/308
* fix(vector): keep the canvas still when entering vector edit mode and picking a region by @rcoenen in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/322
* M9: remove someone from a live session by @HaSh3003 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/338
* fix(ui): step through the font picker with Up and Down (#345) by @vxMacDev in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/352
* fix(engine): drag with the Text tool to make a fixed-width text box (#360) by @vxMacDev in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/363
* Variables export as a download in the browser by @mateusvillain in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/368
* Let batch steps reference ids created by earlier steps by @edivanteixeira in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/400
* M0.9: a control line that isn't JSON ends the connection by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/589
* Community batch 5: 59 reviewed PRs (#482 and up) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/591
* Skip divider rows in Next page and Previous page by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/517
* fix(ui): show error toasts raised by a slow frame for their full 3 s by @volkovskey in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/518
* Keep a styled layer's fill variable through .fig round trips by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/521
* Pen tool: a click's small wobble pulls out no handle by @seun-ipaye in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/522
* Close a layer's colour picker when the selection changes by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/523
* Keep a Rectangle in the smallest synthetic perf documents by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/525
* Fix perf failing with 'no card' on small instance counts by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/526

* Report changed=false when list indentation is capped by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/534
* Fix eraser missing brush crossings narrower than the sample spacing by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/536
